import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    private static final long MOD1 = 998244353L;
    private static final long MOD2 = 1000000007L;
    private static final int MAX_S = 7;
    private static final int PRE_SIZE = 1111110;

    private static List<Long>[] seq = new List[MAX_S];
    private static long[] prefix = new long[MAX_S];
    private static long NTH_VAL;

    private static long diff_mod(long a, long b) {
        return ((a - b) % MOD1 + MOD1) % MOD1;
    }

    private static long next_val(long cur, long limit) {
        if (cur * 10 <= limit) return cur * 10;
        cur++;
        if (cur <= limit) {
            while (cur % 10 == 0) cur /= 10;
        } else {
            cur = (cur - 1) / 10 + 1;
            while (cur % 10 == 0) cur /= 10;
        }
        return cur;
    }

    private static int[] len_arr = new int[1000010];

    private static void preprocess() {
        for (int i = 0; i < MAX_S; i++) {
            seq[i] = new ArrayList<>();
        }
        
        long cur_val = 0, cur_len = 1;
        long idx = 1;
        for (int i = 0; i < PRE_SIZE; ++i) {
            seq[(int)cur_len].add(diff_mod(idx, cur_val));
            idx++;
            if (cur_len < 6) {
                cur_len++;
                cur_val *= 10;
            } else {
                cur_val++;
                while (cur_val % 10 == 0) cur_val /= 10;
                cur_len--;
            }
        }

        for (int l = 1; l < MAX_S; ++l) {
            Collections.sort(seq[l]);
            for (long x : seq[l]) {
                prefix[l] = (prefix[l] + x) % MOD2;
            }
        }

        int edge = 1, f = 0;
        for (int i = 1; i <= 1000000; ++i) {
            if (i == edge) {
                edge *= 10;
                f++;
            }
            len_arr[i] = f;
        }
    }

    private static long compute_segment(long start_val, long start_idx, long limit) {
        long res = 0;
        long st_val = start_val / 100;
        st_val++;
        while (st_val % 10 == 0) st_val /= 10;
        while (start_val != st_val) {
            res = (res + diff_mod(start_idx, start_val)) % MOD2;
            start_idx++;
            start_val = next_val(start_val, limit);
        }
        NTH_VAL = start_idx;
        return res;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        PrintWriter pw = new PrintWriter(System.out);

        preprocess();

        long n = Long.parseLong(br.readLine());

        if (n < 10000000) {
            long ans = 0, val = 1;
            for (long i = 1; i <= n; ++i) {
                ans = (ans + diff_mod(i, val)) % MOD2;
                if (i == n) break;
                val = next_val(val, n);
            }
            pw.println(ans);
            pw.close();
            return;
        }

        long ans = 0, val = 1, idx = 1;
        long block_limit = n / 1000000;

        while (true) {
            ans = (ans + diff_mod(idx, val)) % MOD2;
            idx++;
            if (len_arr[(int)val] == len_arr[(int)block_limit]) {
                if (val == block_limit) {
                    ans = (ans + compute_segment(val * 10, idx, n)) % MOD2;
                    idx = NTH_VAL;
                    break;
                }
                long tmp = val;
                for (int l = 1; l < MAX_S; ++l) {
                    tmp *= 10;
                    long offset = diff_mod(idx - 1, tmp);
                    List<Long> currentSeq = seq[l];
                    int pos = Collections.binarySearch(currentSeq, MOD1 - offset);
                    if (pos < 0) pos = -pos - 1;
                    int cnt = currentSeq.size() - pos;
                    ans = (ans + prefix[l] + cnt * MOD1 % MOD2) % MOD2;
                    ans = (ans + offset * currentSeq.size() % MOD2) % MOD2;
                }
                idx += PRE_SIZE;
            }
            val = next_val(val, block_limit);
        }

        long max_val = 1;
        for (int i = 0; i < len_arr[(int)block_limit] + 6; ++i) max_val *= 10;
        max_val--;
        block_limit = max_val / 1000000;

        val /= 10;
        val++;
        while (val % 10 == 0) val /= 10;

        while (val != 1) {
            ans = (ans + diff_mod(idx, val)) % MOD2;
            idx++;
            if (len_arr[(int)val] == len_arr[(int)block_limit]) {
                long tmp = val;
                for (int l = 1; l < MAX_S; ++l) {
                    tmp *= 10;
                    long offset = diff_mod(idx - 1, tmp);
                    List<Long> currentSeq = seq[l];
                    int pos = Collections.binarySearch(currentSeq, MOD1 - offset);
                    if (pos < 0) pos = -pos - 1;
                    int cnt = currentSeq.size() - pos;
                    ans = (ans + prefix[l] + cnt * MOD1 % MOD2) % MOD2;
                    ans = (ans + offset * currentSeq.size() % MOD2) % MOD2;
                }
                idx += PRE_SIZE;
            }
            val = next_val(val, block_limit);
        }

        pw.println(ans);
        pw.close();
    }
}
